Playbook.name: Change Audit — Removable Media Plugged or Denied (Kaspersky Device Control) - SOC Playbook

ExecutiveSummary.Overview: Kaspersky Device Control logged a removable-storage device plugged or denied on an endpoint (reshaped from the noisy 6416 rule; storage-scoped, 12h suppressed). Triage: expected user USB use / a blocked device (benign), or unauthorised removable-media use for exfiltration/malware introduction?
ExecutiveSummary.BusinessImpact: Removable media is a vector for data exfiltration and malware introduction; device-control logs track it.

TelemetryRequirements.Requirement: Kaspersky Security Center CEF (verified live). Fields: destination.domain (the affected ENDPOINT, not the collector), destination.user.name, cef.device.event_class_id, cef.name, message (malware name/path/SHA256), source.ip. Use destination.domain as the host of interest.

InitialAssessment.Rule: Weigh the full evidence story per the ClassificationGuidance, not any single fact.

Investigation.Goal: Determine whether the removable-media event is expected user activity/a benign block or unauthorised use warranting review.

Step.name: Removable-media events on the endpoint
Step.Purpose: Plugged (allowed) vs denied, the device, and the user separate routine use from policy violations.
Step.Query: FROM logs-cef.log-* | WHERE cef.device.vendor == "KasperskyLab" AND cef.device.event_class_id IN ("GNRL_EV_DEVCTRL_DEV_PLUGGED","GNRL_EV_DEVCTRL_DEV_PLUG_DENIED") AND destination.domain == "$endpoint" AND @timestamp >= NOW() - 4 hours | STATS events = COUNT(*), classes = VALUES(cef.device.event_class_id), users = VALUES(destination.user.name), devices = VALUES(message) | LIMIT 1
Step.AnalystNotes: DENIED = device control blocked the device (policy working - usually benign). PLUGGED (allowed) on a sensitive host by an unexpected user may warrant a data-handling review. Read message for the device (Kingston DataTraveler etc.).

Step.name: Is this endpoint/user expected to use removable media
Step.Purpose: Frequency and the host's role separate routine authorised use from anomalous use.
Step.Query: FROM logs-cef.log-* | WHERE cef.device.vendor == "KasperskyLab" AND cef.device.event_class_id RLIKE "(?i).*devctrl.*" AND destination.domain == "$endpoint" AND @timestamp >= NOW() - 4 hours | STATS events = COUNT(*), denied = COUNT(CASE(cef.device.event_class_id == "GNRL_EV_DEVCTRL_DEV_PLUG_DENIED", 1, null)) | LIMIT 1
Step.AnalystNotes: Mostly-denied = device control enforcing policy (benign). Allowed use on a restricted host by an unexpected user is the review case.

Node.Condition: Allowed removable-storage use on a restricted/sensitive host by an unexpected user (data-exfil risk).
Node.Result: Needs Escalation (data-handling review) or True Positive if exfil confirmed

Node.Condition: A denied device (device control blocked it - policy working).
Expected removable-media use by an authorised user per policy.
Repeated denied attempts to bypass device control.
Node.Result: True Positive (Policy Circumvention Attempt - review user)

DocumentationChecklist.Item: Attach outputs of INV-01-USB-EVENTS, INV-02-USB-CONTEXT to the case.

FalsePositive.Definition: Expected/authorised removable-media use, or a benign block.

SOCAction.Item: Confirm policy compliance; close as benign_activity.

Indicators.Item: Allowed use on a restricted host by an unexpected user.

SOCAction.Item: Review the data handled; interview the user; tighten device-control policy; escalate if exfil.

Misconfiguration.Definition: An over-permissive or mis-scoped device-control policy.

Indicators.Item: Policy allows media it should not.

Phase.name: Immediate Actions (0-30 minutes)
Phase.Action: Identify the endpoint/user and whether the media use is authorised.
For allowed use on sensitive hosts, review data handled.

Phase.name: Containment and Eradication (hours)
Phase.Action: Review data handled; interview the user; tighten device-control policy.

QualityChecks.Check: Kaspersky reports the endpoint in destination.domain (host.* is the collector pod) - always pivot on destination.domain.
The CEF pipeline occasionally mislabels events - see the pipeline health note in the phase-1 report.

TruePositiveClosure.Item: Data handling reviewed; policy tightened; user addressed.
